content.cycle_basis: sum of per-file distinct tester Cycle values across parsed CSV parts, including HPPC and reference tests; not the WLTP aging-folder counter or an independently reconciled count of full aging cycles

quality.notes: Three cells aged to 70% (300k km), 40% (206k km) and 15% (95k km) SOH. One partial download marker (Data Summary.tab.part) is present. Cell spec from A123's official ANR26650M1-B datasheet. voltage_min_V left unset: this document does not state a discharge cutoff voltage explicitly (only charge parameters and discharge current limits); other sources commonly cite 2.0V for this cell family but that was not independently confirmed here. Charge/discharge rate estimates, where explicitly marked raw_data in the citations, use signed observed current extrema divided by the stored nominal Ah. These are measurement estimates over the cached extraction scope, not imposed CC protocol setpoints; they may include pulse, dynamic, regenerative or diagnostic segments and measurement excursions. Current units and direction were checked against the cited original headers, status labels or separate charge/discharge counters. cached ranges cover all parsed CSV parts of three cells; the maximum charge value was independently located in one HPPC CSV. The charge maximum is an HPPC pulse, so it does not describe a sustained recharge rate. Both observed directional maxima now use cached global current extrema: 8.00052C charge in an HPPC pulse, and 19.2004C discharge in a WLTP segment. The global -48.001 A was independently located in 2-95k km case.zip::95k km case/Cycle 0/951_WLTP_90a.csv line 506, with Current [A] and sign checked against DCH/CHA rows. The 1C value remains the reference-discharge protocol; 15.00176C is only a separately traced HPPC subset peak. The extracted cycle total counts per-file tester cycles across diagnostic and aging parts; it is not the independently reconciled WLTP aging-folder count.
